name: calculator
description: Performs basic mathematical operations between two numbers: addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, modulo, and power.

a.description: The first number (or base in power).

b.description: The second number (or exponent in power).

name: web_search
description: Searches the web for facts, information, current data, definitions, and knowledge on any topic.

query.description: The search query keywords to look up on the web.

name: date_time
description: Gets the current date, time, day of the week, year, and timezone. Useful for knowing today's date, current time, or answering questions related to dates and years.

timezone.description: Optional timezone name such as 'local', 'UTC', 'Asia/Kolkata', or 'America/New_York'. Defaults to 'local'.

name: retrieve_student_info
description: RAG Document Retrieval Tool. Searches and retrieves relevant student records from the Student Database document based on student name, student ID, department, attendance, placement eligibility, or subject marks.

query.description: Search keyword or filter criteria (e.g. 'Priya Sharma', 'STU001', 'CSE', 'AIDS', 'highest overall', 'attendance below 75%', 'placement eligible', 'AI above 90').
